turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is a fraud awareness message from the National Cyber Crime Helpline.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Scammers may claim to be police, CBI, or bank officials and ask for OTP or money transfers.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Remember, no real officer will ask for OTP, PIN, or tell you to stay on a video call.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: If you receive such a call, hang up and call 1930 immediately.
